# Pixel Pomodoro Timer

A pixel-art styled Pomodoro timer built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No build step, no dependencies, works offline.

## Features

- 25-minute work mode and 5-minute break mode
- Large MM:SS countdown display
- Start / Pause and Reset buttons
- Manual mode switching between Work and Break
- Keyboard shortcuts:
  - `Space` — start / pause
  - `R` — reset current timer
  - `W` — switch to Work mode
  - `B` — switch to Break mode
- Accessible controls with ARIA labels and visible focus states
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server required.

## Palette

- Background: `#1a1a2e`
- Card: `#16213e`
- Accent: `#e94560`
- Text: `#edf2f4`
- Muted: `#8d99ae`
- Break accent: `#4ecdc4`

## Files

- `index.html` — markup and structure
- `style.css` — pixel-themed styling and responsive layout
- `app.js` — timer logic, state management, keyboard shortcuts
